provenance.canonical-source: apps/v4/registry/new-york-v4/ui/popover.tsx — six exported parts (Popover, PopoverTrigger, PopoverContent, PopoverAnchor, PopoverHeader, PopoverTitle, PopoverDescription), every one a thin data-slot wrapper around the external, unvendored `radix-ui` package's Popover primitive (package.json:80 "radix-ui": "^1.4.3", no node_modules/radix-ui anywhere in this clone) — the same external-package boundary DROPDOWN-MENU-MATRIX.md/ACCORDION-MATRIX.md/TOAST-MATRIX.md already recorded. Every STYLE value below comes from this file's own literal className strings, real, committed source, even though the code that sets the data-state attributes those classes key off lives externally. This column is genuinely RICHER in structure than dropdown-menu's or tooltip's own shadcn columns: it ships dedicated PopoverHeader/PopoverTitle/PopoverDescription sub-components (the same family shadcn's own Dialog has), a structural family neither of those two components has. See POPOVER-MATRIX.md §0.
provenance.popup-bg / popup-fg: PopoverContent: `bg-popover text-popover-foreground` -> --popover/--popover-foreground (globals.css:105-106 light, :148-149 dark). Reused verbatim from dropdown-menu.shadcn.json's/select.shadcn.json's own identical slots.
provenance.popup-border: PopoverContent's bare `border` utility, no colour class -> --border (globals.css:117/:160).
provenance.popup-shadow: PopoverContent class `shadow-md`. [R] — Tailwind's documented default two-layer value; radix-ui is not vendored in this clone. Reused verbatim from dropdown-menu.shadcn.json's own popup-shadow.
provenance.popup-width: PopoverContent class `w-72` = 288px, a FIXED width applied regardless of content — a real, sourced contrast with Salt's own content-sized `width: max-content`. Demo files (popover-demo.tsx) sometimes override this per-instance with `className="w-80"`, confirming the base w-72 is a real, overridable DEFAULT, not a hard cap.
provenance.popup-font-off: CONFIRMED OFF — PopoverContent's own className string (`z-50 w-72 origin-(--radix-popover-content-transform-origin) rounded-md border bg-popover p-4 text-popover-foreground shadow-md outline-hidden ...`) has NO text-size utility of any kind, unlike dropdown-menu's own `text-sm` or tooltip's own `text-xs` root text sizing — children choose their own type entirely (the demo's own paragraph sets `text-sm` itself, not the component).
provenance.popup-outline-hidden: PopoverContent class `outline-hidden` — Tailwind's forced-colors-safe focus-outline-suppression utility (a transparent, still-technically-present outline for Windows High Contrast Mode, not a bare `outline:none`); approximated here as `outline: none` for this template's single-property row, a declared simplification of the exact Windows-high-contrast nuance.
provenance.popup-entrance-transition: PopoverContent class `data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=open]:fade-in-0 data-[state=open]:zoom-in-95 data-[state=closed]:animate-out data-[state=closed]:fade-out-0 data-[state=closed]:zoom-out-95` plus four `data-[side=*]:slide-in-from-*` variants — the SAME unvendored `tw-animate-css` caveat toast.shadcn.json/dropdown-menu.shadcn.json/tooltip.shadcn.json already carry (package.json dependency, no vendored keyframe CSS in this clone).
provenance.popup-padding: PopoverContent class `p-4` = 16px uniform, applied directly to the content root (no separate inner wrapper — see structure.content).
provenance.header-padding-off: CONFIRMED OFF — PopoverHeader's own className is `flex flex-col gap-1 text-sm`, no padding utility of its own; it inherits the popup root's own p-4 (a real, sourced contrast with Salt's OWN doubly-padded header-plus-content-wrapper structure, where OverlayHeader carries its own independent spacing-100 padding on top of OverlayPanelContent's own padding one level down).
provenance.title-font: PopoverTitle class `font-medium` — ONLY a font-weight utility (500); no font-size/line-height/family utility of any kind, so size is left entirely UNSET/inherited from the ambient (popup-root-less, since popup-font is itself off) page font — a real, sourced contrast with dropdown-menu's own fully-specified item/label type.
provenance.description-color: PopoverDescription class `text-muted-foreground` -> --muted-foreground (globals.css:112/:155), the SAME slot dropdown-menu.shadcn.json's own fg-muted already resolves.
provenance.description-font: PopoverDescription: no dedicated className beyond inheriting PopoverHeader's own `text-sm` ancestor class — text-sm = 0.875rem/1.25rem; family read as the generic Tailwind stack per Button's own precedent (neither this nor PopoverHeader sets an explicit font-sans/Geist utility), the SAME convention tooltip.shadcn.json's/dropdown-menu.shadcn.json's own type rows use.
provenance.arrow-off: CONFIRMED ABSENT — grepped popover.tsx in full plus every example/demo file under examples/{aria,base,radix}/popover-*.tsx: no PopoverPrimitive.Arrow anywhere.
provenance.header-actions-off: CONFIRMED ABSENT — PopoverHeader's own className carries no trailing/actions slot of any kind, unlike shadcn's own DialogHeader (out of this component's scope, cited for contrast only).
provenance.close-button-off: CONFIRMED ABSENT — no PopoverClose-equivalent part is exported or composed anywhere in popover.tsx, a real, structural contrast with shadcn's OWN Dialog (which DOES export DialogClose). See POPOVER-MATRIX.md Finding 3.
provenance.content-off: CONFIRMED ABSENT — PopoverContent IS the content container itself; there is no separate inner scrollable wrapper the way Salt's OverlayPanelContent is.
provenance.modal-focus-trap-off: Radix's own documented Popover.Root `modal` prop defaults to `false` — no focus trap, the rest of the page stays fully interactive while the popover is open. [R], Radix's own published API default, not independently confirmable at the exact mechanism level in this unvendored clone. See POPOVER-MATRIX.md Finding 2.
provenance.placement-align: Radix's own `side`/`align`/`sideOffset` props on Popover.Content — popover.tsx destructures `align = "center"` and `sideOffset = 4` with explicit defaults [S]; `side` itself is passed through via `...props` with no override in this file, so its literal default ("bottom") is Radix Popper's own documented default [R].
